goal.objective: Build a static Astro portfolio site in the aiportfolio repo for Ralph Luis Abejuela (light clean minimal design, emerald green accent, system fonts, zero external JS frameworks, no scroll hijacking) that mirrors resume.tex: one-page homepage with hero (face-cropped/compressed headshot from DSC_3490.JPG, name, title, location, tagline), experience (DOST backend intern, CSC Treasurer), skills+stack, projects (ejobtrack, Agri-Connect, Tagisan ng Talino Codefest), education, interests, blog teaser, and contact+socials (mailto, LinkedIn, GitHub); separate /blog route + /blog/[slug] pages using Astro content collections with 3 posts drafted from resume material (ejobtrack writeup, DOST internship, local LLMs); GEO/SEO-optimized for AI-platform citation: JSON-LD Person structured data, semantic HTML, quotable bullet-form content, per-page meta descriptions, OG tags, sitemap, robots.txt, llms.txt; Cloudflare Pages deploy readiness (site URL set in astro.config, `astro build` passes, README deploy steps).
goal.verificationContract:
1. `pnpm build` exits with code 0.
2. `dist/index.html` exists and contains: a face-cropped headshot image in the hero, section ids for experience, skills, projects, education, interests, and contact, plus the three social links (mailto:abejuela.ralph.balatucan@gmail.com, linkedin.com/in/ralph-abejuela, github.com/ralph-abejuela).
3. `dist/blog/index.html` exists and at least 3 posts render as `dist/blog/<slug>/index.html`.
4. No built page contains an external `<script src=...>` reference; total inline JavaScript across all built HTML is under 20KB.
5. `dist/index.html` contains `application/ld+json` structured data with Person schema, a meta description, and Open Graph tags; `dist/robots.txt`, `dist/sitemap-index.xml`, and `public/llms.txt` exist.
6. Headshot file in public/ is under 200KB and is the image referenced by the hero.
7. astro.config.mjs sets a `site` URL and README.md documents Cloudflare Pages deploy steps.

pendingCompletion.completionSummary:
Outcome: Static Astro portfolio for Ralph Luis Abejuela — light minimal design, emerald accent, zero external JS, GEO/SEO optimized. Homepage: hero (face-cropped headshot), experience, skills, projects, education, interests, blog teaser, contact+socials. /blog + 3 markdown posts (ejobtrack, DOST internship, local LLMs). JSON-LD Person/BlogPosting/WebSite, per-page meta + OG, sitemap-index.xml, robots.txt, llms.txt. Cloudflare Pages ready (site URL + README steps).
Changed: astro.config.mjs (site + sitemap), src/content.config.ts, src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro, src/pages/index.astro, src/pages/blog/index.astro, src/pages/blog/[slug].astro, src/data/site.ts, src/styles/global.css, src/env.d.ts, 3 blog posts, public/robots.txt, public/llms.txt, public/images/headshot.jpg (49KB face crop via OpenCV), README.md. Added deps: @astrojs/sitemap, @tailwindcss/typography, sharp (dev).
Evidence: pnpm build exits 0, 5 static pages; independent 30/30 contract check passed (section ids, 3 social links, 3 post pages, 0 external scripts, 8.2KB inline JS, JSON-LD + OG + sitemap + robots + llms.txt, headshot 48.4KB < 200KB); lens_diagnostics clean across 14 files.
Tests: `pnpm build` (pass), dist artifact greps (pass, 30/30).
Unresolved: User should eyeball the headshot crop (%TEMP%\headshot-preview.jpg) — crop is heuristic (OpenCV face detect, face at 65%/22% of photo); adjust via crop script if off. Actual Cloudflare deploy is a manual dashboard action. pi-lens `astro:content` false positive marked + fixed via env.d.ts reference.
Next: Verify headshot crop, then push to GitHub and connect Cloudflare Pages (README has steps); swap placeholder domain ralph-abejuela.pages.dev for real domain when assigned.
